description: This plot illustrates the Mean Interclass Similarity across a sequence of unlabeled data points for three different methods and their respective averages. The x-axis is unlabeled, features a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 65, and has numeric tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Mean Interclass Similarity," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, and has tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six lines. The "w/o DPO obo" data is represented by a solid blue line with dot markers; it begins at an x-value of 0 with a y-value of approximately 0.22, exhibits a sharp peak at x=1 with a y-value near 0.49, fluctuates significantly across the x-axis with another prominent peak near x=31 at y=0.48, and ends near x=64 with a y-value of approximately 0.02. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" data is shown as a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at x=0 with a y-value of approximately 0.10, displays high volatility with notable peaks at x=16 (y=0.39), x=31 (y=0.46), and x=61 (y=0.47), before ending near x=64 at y=0.08. The "DPO" data is depicted by a solid green line with small cross markers; it begins at x=0 with a y-value of approximately 0.19, generally fluctuates at lower values compared to the other solid lines, reaches a local maximum near x=1 at y=0.21, and concludes near x=64 at y=0.06. Additionally, three horizontal dashed lines without markers represent the averages for each method, with their exact values printed on the left side of the graph: the "Average of w/o DPO obo" is a blue dashed line constant at y=0.107, the "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" is an orange dashed line constant at y=0.158, and the "Average of DPO" is a green dashed line constant at y=0.086.
